q1_indexed_trend: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: 30-day counts; each series divided by its 2019 value.
q1_deaths_30d: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash.
q1_rates: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población. Period: 1993–2024; the per-inhabitant panel from 2002, where the resident series begins. Definition: injury crashes and 30-day deaths divided by the registered vehicle fleet, and 30-day deaths divided by residents on 1 July; computed from those counts and denominators rather than read from DGT's published rates, which are rounded and whose population for 2023 and 2024 differs from the INE residents the geography page divides by.
q1_monthly_heatmap: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: 30-day deaths in the month as a share of the year.
q1_deaths_by_zone: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash. n = 15,441 deaths.
q2_hour_weekday_crashes: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: count of injury crashes. n = 875,013 crashes.
q2_hour_weekday_fatal_share: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: fatal crashes (30 days) divided by all injury crashes. n = 875,013 crashes.
q2_night_share: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: darkness = lighting codes 4–6 (no daylight, with or without street lighting); 30-day deaths. n = 15,441 deaths.
q2_hour_band_road_group: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: fatal crashes (30 days) divided by all injury crashes; the 85 crashes with no road type are left out. n = 874,928 crashes.
q5_road_user_shares: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024, all roads. Definition: each year's 30-day deaths as shares by the vehicle the person was using, stacked to 100%; trucks, buses, other and unspecified folded together; personal mobility vehicles counted separately only from 2020. n = 15,441 deaths.
q5_driver_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: drivers only, 30-day deaths; panels have their own scales; PMV series starts in 2020.
q5_pedestrian_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash.
q4_province_deaths: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población. Period: 2024. Definition: 30-day deaths in the province where the crash happened, divided by residents on 1 July; exact Poisson 95% intervals, wide where deaths are few. n = 1,785 deaths.
q4_national_rates: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025. Period: 2002–2024 (residents), 2014–2024 (licence holders). Definition: 30-day deaths of all road users; residents on 1 July; licence holders from that year's census, which DGT publishes without a reference date.
q7_ladder_ratio: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain); MOVILIA 2006 (Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible). Period: 2014–2024. Definition: driver deaths (30 days) per unit of each denominator, 65+ divided by 35–64; shaded bands are 95% intervals from the death counts; drivers with unknown age excluded.
q7_licence_travel_share: Source: DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain); MOVILIA 2006 (Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible). Period: 2024. Definition: licence holders divided by residents; travel-weighted share = ESRA national share of adults who drive spread by the MOVILIA 2006 car-travel profile, capped at the licence share.
q7_death_rates_by_band: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain); MOVILIA 2006 (Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible). Period: 2014–2024. Definition: driver deaths within 30 days (interurban and urban) divided by licence holders and by travel-weighted drivers of the same age band; same scale on every panel.
q7_involvement_fragility: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: left: drivers involved in injury crashes per 10,000 licence holders of the band; right: driver deaths per 1,000 drivers involved (fragility and crash severity).
q7_victims_by_age: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población. Period: 2002–2024. Definition: all road users killed within 30 days, by age band, divided by residents on 1 July.
q6_rates_per_km: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: vehicles of each type involved in injury crashes and in 30-day fatal crashes, and their drivers and passengers killed within 30 days, divided by the type's estimated vehicle-kilometres (circulating fleet × mean annual km from ITV odometer readings); whiskers are exact 95% Poisson intervals; rows ordered by fatal-crash involvement; trucks over 3,500 kg include tractor units and articulated vehicles; each panel has its own horizontal scale from zero, so the panels compare the order of the rows, not magnitudes across panels. n = 151,542 vehicles involved.
q6_per_vehicle_vs_per_km: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: vehicles of each type involved in 30-day fatal crashes per 100,000 circulating vehicles (left) and per billion vehicle-km (right); the lines show how each type's rank moves when distance driven replaces fleet size as the denominator.
q6_km_by_age: Source: DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: mean annual km per vehicle, modelled from annualised ITV odometer readings and imputed to the circulating fleet; valid for aggregates, not for individual vehicles. n = 32,522,330 vehicles.
q6_occupant_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash, drivers and passengers of each vehicle type; panels have their own scales; personal mobility vehicles are counted from 2020.
q8_points_series: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: January 2000 to November 2007, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash; fitted = Poisson regression with a linear trend, month terms and a level and slope change at July 2006; counterfactual = the same model with the change set to zero; the post-period ends before the Penal Code reform of December 2007. n = 38,852 deaths.
q8_points_series_long: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: January 2000 to December 2009, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash; the model of the previous figure with a second level change at December 2007 (shaded); the recession of 2008 is not modelled. n = 44,963 deaths.
q8_points_placebo: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 38 placebo breaks from January 2002 to February 2005 plus the true break of July 2006, each with a 17-month post-period. Definition: the same segmented regression refitted with a false intervention date; the filled marker is the true date; a real effect should sit in the tail of this distribution. n = 39 fits.
q8_speed_series: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: January 2016 to February 2020. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash by road type of the crash; fitted = one Poisson regression for both groups with a shared trend, month terms, a group term, a post term and a post × conventional term; counterfactual = conventional roads without their own change; both panels share one vertical scale. n = 5,230 deaths.
q8_speed_series_long: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: January 2016 to December 2024. Definition: the model of the previous figure extended with lockdown and restriction periods (shaded), each with its own level for both groups and for conventional roads; both panels share one vertical scale. n = 10,741 deaths.
q9_speed_status_interurban: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: drivers involved in injury crashes by the police's record of a speed infraction (yearbook tables 6.1); 'unknown' is the share for which no judgement was recorded. n = 655,982 drivers.
q9_speed_status_urban: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: drivers involved in injury crashes by the police's record of a speed infraction (yearbook tables 6.1); 'unknown' is the share for which no judgement was recorded. n = 1,138,424 drivers.
q9_speed_by_vehicle: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024. Period: 2024. Definition: drivers with a speed infraction divided by drivers whose speed status was recorded (all roads); whiskers are 95% Wilson intervals; about half of all drivers have no record, and the recorded half is not a random sample; drivers of an unknown vehicle type (194, of whom 21 had a speed infraction) are in the 'all drivers' reference line but not shown as a row. n = 81,535 drivers with a record.
q9_report_speed_share: Source: DGT Observatorio Nacional de Seguridad Vial, Informe temático Factor Velocidad (March 2025); Spain without Cataluña and País Vasco. Period: 2014–2023. Definition: injury crashes in which the police recorded inappropriate speed as a concurrent factor, as the report's rounded share of that road type's injury crashes, plotted for interurban roads, urban streets and all roads.
q9_report_speed_limit: Source: DGT Observatorio Nacional de Seguridad Vial, Informe temático Factor Velocidad (March 2025); Spain without Cataluña and País Vasco. Period: 2023. Definition: crashes and 30-day deaths with inappropriate speed as a factor, by the posted limit of the road, as shares of that year's totals (5,070 crashes, 319 deaths).
q9_report_day_hour: Source: DGT Observatorio Nacional de Seguridad Vial, Informe temático Factor Velocidad (March 2025); Spain without Cataluña and País Vasco. Period: 2014–2023 pooled, all roads. Definition: injury crashes with inappropriate speed as a factor by weekday and hour of the crash. n = 57,383 crashes.
q3_forest_fatal: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: logistic regression of at least one death on the circumstances shown plus year; odds ratios against the reference level (hollow marker) with 95% intervals clustered by province; road surface 'not specified' (547 crashes) has no crash of this outcome, so it cannot be estimated and is left out of the plot. n = 875,013 crashes.
q3_forest_serious: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: logistic regression of death or hospitalisation on the circumstances shown plus year; odds ratios against the reference level (hollow marker) with 95% intervals clustered by province. n = 875,013 crashes.
q3_calibration: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: fitted on 2016–2022, scored on 2023–2024. Definition: crashes grouped into ten equal-sized groups (deciles) of predicted probability; the dotted line is perfect calibration. n = 203,302 crashes.
q3_year_stability: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024, one fit per year. Definition: odds ratios for a fatal outcome: the ten largest effects of the full model among the levels that record a value — a level standing for a missing state ('not specified', 'not applicable' or a field's explicit unknown code) tracks reporting practice, not risk, and is left out — each refitted on one year of crashes and clustered by province like the full model; shaded bands are 95% intervals.
q3_predicted_grid: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: model of 2016–2024, predictions for 2024. Definition: every other circumstance at its reference level (side collision, two vehicles, not at a junction, clear, dry, weekday, 10:00–13:59; interurban zone for interurban road types).
data_missingness: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: observed = not empty, not 999 (not specified), not 998 (not applicable) and not an explicit unknown code; the fields that carry no code list count their placeholder values as not observed too — KM 9999 (and 1000 in 2019, the year DGT used it), CARRETERA 'No inventariada' and COD_MUNICIPIO 00000. n = 875,013 crashes.
